Query:

 TO 's3://resstock-core/bsq_athena_unload_results/3a6327a8ad05098c44c190e0e49d59896f98a0b153e9f1072fbb109e0986cd92/aaf2eeaa-d7da-4d9f-aa0f-d64881a277b6/'
